verdict.rationale: Greenhouse offers several automated, always-on capabilities—webhooks that fire on pipeline events, bulk automated outreach campaigns, ML-driven offer forecasting, and 'scalable workflows' automation—that run in the background without manual triggering. However, there's no evidence of a user-facing automation builder (custom triggers/conditions/schedules) that an AI-native user could configure themselves; the automations are mostly fixed, built-in product features rather than user-defined agentic workflows. Missing for 10: a configurable automation/workflow builder, scheduling controls, and evidence of user-authored autonomous rules beyond the fixed feature set.
